title: Material Blend 2-Mix Solo #28 (인어비늘+석재)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, high ponytail swept sleek — her entire body, from neck to ankle, is a random intermingled mix of two materials with no spatial division at all — not left versus right, not top versus bottom, but irregular patches of each scattered all over her body in a marbled, organic distribution, exactly like natural mineral veining. mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC CYAN scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow and solid polished white marble fused directly into her own form, natural grey-gold veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING pale marble surface with VIVID golden vein striations are woven through each other everywhere: a patch of one material on one shoulder, immediately beside it a patch of the other, then the first again across the ribs, the second at the hip, the first down one thigh, the second across the opposite calf — the two materials never separating into a clean zone anywhere on her body, every square inch densely interlocking, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
